'''Red Rock''' is an island in the [[Unquiet Ocean]], located south-east of the [[Void Knights' Outpost]]. It can be accessed following partial completion of the [[The Red Reef]] quest.

It includes a [[bank chest]], [[Sailors' Marker|sailors' marker]], [[salvaging station]], [[notice board]], and [[ledger table]].

==Transportation==
Partial completion of the quest [[The Red Reef]] is required to access Red Rock
* Teleport with the [[sailors' amulet]] (requires inspecting [[Sailors' Marker]] before using)
* Sailing to the gangplank on the east of the dock
* [[Charter ship]] {{Charter ship fares}}

==Features==
* [[File:Bank icon.png|link=Bank chest]] [[Bank chest|Bank chest]]
* [[File:Transportation icon.png|link=Charter ship]] [[Charter ship]]
* 3 [[Seagull#Level_3|seagulls]]
* A [[rope]] spawn on the south-west dock
* A [[saw]] spawn on a crate in the south-west of the building
* A [[hammer]] spawn on a crate in the middle of the building
* 4 [[seaweed]] spawns which are unreachable from the docks

==Sailing info==
Players can [[mooring point|dock]] at Red Rock with level 52 [[Sailing]]. The dock offers the following utilities for sailors:
*[[File:Shipwright map icon.png|link=Shipwright]] [[Shipwright]]
*[[File:Port task board icon.png|link=Notice board]] [[Notice board]] - requires completion of [[The Red Reef]]
*[[File:Salvaging station map icon.png|link=Salvaging station]] [[Salvaging station]]
*[[File:Ledger table icon.png|link=Ledger table]] [[Ledger table]]
